  • Method Details

    • patientIdentifier

      public static Optional<Identifier> patientIdentifier(Object request, Map<String,Object> parameters)
      Determines the identifier of the patient the conditional update or delete is about. In this order, it is taken from
      1. the Iti104Parameters the Manager has received
      2. the Iti104Constants.ITI104_PATIENT_IDENTIFIER_HEADER header
      3. the request itself, if it is an identifier (for a delete) or a Patient that has exactly one identifier (for an update)
      Parameters:
      request - request, i.e. the Patient or the identifier of the patient to be deleted
      parameters - request parameters or Camel headers
      Returns:
      the identifier of the patient, if it could be determined
